subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Do the security and CI/release owners accept these 13 upstream action revisions for the affected secret-bearing, scanning, release, and agent workflows once representative exact-head checks finish?
rationale: No mechanical patch defect is established, but third-party executable bundles cross sensitive workflow boundaries that require repository-owner trust and cannot all be proven through ordinary pull-request execution.

options.title: Approve after owner review
options.body: Merge after secops and CI/release owners review the upstream ranges and the representative exact-head checks complete successfully.

options.title: Split sensitive families
options.body: Separate token, Codex, Docker, and CodeQL updates into smaller PRs when owners need independent source review or rollout evidence.

options.title: Pause the grouped refresh
options.body: Leave the existing pins in place until the sensitive action families can be audited or validated individually.

recommendation.title: Approve after owner review
recommendation.body: Merge after secops and CI/release owners review the upstream ranges and the representative exact-head checks complete successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history spans CODEOWNERS, workflow runtime modernization, Docker hardening, and Codex workflow ownership.
